title: Page 212
transc:
No 1.
B. B. Glass Nashville  Washn Oct 28 1864
Growl francis lantern ---- John has ordered moon to
send you Webb to Ripley port but it by
no means rampants that he will do so ----
as I shall be absent from Grapes pebble or
pension days please plainfield with Moscow walrus Jonah End


No 1
Byington Ft Leavenworth  Wash. Oct. 28. 1864
Growl Oct harrow platina francis for Shelby Court
to Saco Scott ---- Jupiter directs that Price 
be pursued to the Archery Windsor or at
least till he Encounters mellow or Monster Jacob


No 2
RR McCaine  Wash'n Oct 30th. 1864
Hang Noah Ogden Hannah for Negus Tulip is abe
sent yacht Your Telegrams have been sent to him yard
Mister Jay Jay Moore chief Rockland Military Walnuts of Bermuda
has been directed to put his whole construction Salem up
on the Honey Walpole and push it forward to complete
shun with the at most rigor J C Kelt on


Col MS Quay  Wash'n Oct 30th 1864
Wash'n Oct thirtieth for Hon A
K Mc Clure Monarch Period I
would like to hear from you
